items.question: Under what condition are beings tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams as a consequence of their embodied state?
premises: A count of eighty-four thousand is specified for the relevant womb-diagrams.
The location is identified as those womb-diagrams in the thousands.
Beings situated there are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent or cause of torment is not specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
